title-html: PIXELIZATION — Image to Pixel Art Converter
title-desc: Turn a photograph into a pixelated artwork.
label-custom-description: Choose the colors to apply across the image from dark to light. More colors create more brightness levels; the selected colors are mapped to the image in brightness order.
upload-hint: Drop an image here or choose a file.
upload-change: Click the image to replace it
error-type: Invalid file type. Please choose a PNG, JPG, WEBP, or GIF image.
error-failed: We could not pixelize that image. Please try another file.
examples-description: Choose a sample image and palette to open it in the editor.
compare-slider-label: Adjust the before and after comparison
preview-hint: Use the mouse wheel to zoom and drag to pan.
preview-shortcuts-drag: With the Hand tool, drag the image
edit-colors-hint: Select a connected area with the Magic Wand, then paint inside it with the brush.
selection-ready: Area selected. Switch to Brush to paint inside it.
selection-instruction: Click an area in the image with the Magic Wand to select it.
custom-palette-hint: Choose 2 to 16 colors for a reusable custom palette. Applying it to update the image.
help-page-description: Learn how to use PIXELIZATION to choose a pixel size and palette, upload an image, edit it, and download your artwork.
help-page-back: Back to the image pixelization tool
privacy-meta-description: Learn how PIXELIZATION handles uploaded images, browser storage, server logs, and advertising cookies.
privacy-intro: PIXELIZATION is an image pixelization tool. This policy explains how we handle images and settings you provide, browser storage, and cookies that may be used when ads are shown on this site.
privacy-images-body: When you select an image for pixelization, the image file and conversion settings are sent to this site's conversion API to generate and return the result. The image is processed on the conversion server. The application does not write uploaded images to a long-term database, but the server uses temporary files to process uploads. Temporary-file cleanup is managed by the server environment, and this site has not set a fixed retention period. Do not upload confidential images that you do not want sent to the conversion server.
privacy-local-body: This site uses your browser's localStorage to remember interface language, theme, font, and the 'Remember my last image' preference. Only when you enable 'Remember my last image' does the site save your most recent original image, converted result, and related editing settings in IndexedDB on your device. Turning this option off stops future saves. To delete saved image data, select 'Delete saved data' in Settings or clear this site's data in your browser.
privacy-logs-body: To maintain the service and troubleshoot issues, the conversion service records technical information such as request method, path, response status, processing time, and image dimensions. Error messages may also be recorded for diagnostics. These application logs do not contain image-file contents. Hosting providers may process connection logs under their own security and operations policies.
privacy-cookie-title: Cookies, Google AdSense, and third-party ads
privacy-cookie-body: The PIXELIZATION tool uses localStorage and IndexedDB for preferences and optional recent projects; these features are different from cookies. When Google AdSense ads are shown on this site, Google and its partners may use cookies to serve personalized ads based on your prior visits to this site or other sites. Other third-party ad vendors may also use cookies or similar technologies to serve and measure ads.

help-intro: A simple tool to turn images into pixel art. Choose an image, tune the look, and download your result.
help-step-1-description: Size controls the pixel detail. The palette sets which colors are used.
help-step-2-description: Choose a file or drag it into the workspace. Supported formats include PNG, JPEG, and GIF; the file limit is 5 MB.
help-step-3-description: Fine-tune the pixelation settings. Open edit mode to make manual changes with tools such as the magic wand and brush.
help-step-4-description: When you’re happy with the result, select Download to save it.
storage-description: Save the latest original and converted image on this device and resume it automatically next time. Turn off to stop future saves; delete existing data below.
